nodes.title: Gemini API (NeedAPIKey)
widgets_values: 請將音檔內容依據時間，輸出成LRC歌詞格式檔案，輸出內容不可以有任何說明，要以歌詞的時間開始，內容是英文
Return only the prompt text itself. No explanations or formatting.

Except for the use of the proprietary Gemini API, the rest of the video was created entirely with open-source models. It utilizes a fully automated workflow that includes Index-TTS, Float, WanVideo, GimmVFI, and Loop. With this setup, you simply need to provide a photo and some text, and it will generate a talking video like this. The hardware requirements are modest—only 12GB of memory is sufficient to run it. Including the VFI process, the full video can be generated in about 30 minutes.
Thanks to the segment-based sampling approach, the background may vary slightly between segments, but the character remains generally stable. If needed, you can add a quality enhancement step to the video or manually correct the subtitles to ensure the final content is more complete.
